## mise config for opencode-ai-context-plugin.
#
# Self-contained: this file does NOT depend on (and is not merged with)
# the root `ai-context` monorepo's own `mise.toml` (Docker-stack infra
# tasks for Postgres/Qdrant/reranker) -- it only exists for as long as
# this package still lives inside that monorepo. Once extracted to its
# own repository this file keeps working unchanged; nothing in it
# assumes anything about the parent repo's structure.
#
# `mise install` in this directory pins the dev toolchain; `mise run
# <task>` wraps this package's own npm scripts / setup script so a
# contributor doesn't need to remember npm script names.

[tools]
# Matches this package's devDependencies (@types/node ^22.0.0) and the
# esbuild bundle's node18 compatibility target (scripts/build.mjs) --
# 22 is simply the newest LTS at/after that floor, used for local dev/
# test/build tooling. Note: the BUNDLED plugin file itself is loaded and
# executed by OpenCode's own Bun runtime at use-time, not by this Node
# install -- this only pins the toolchain used to develop/build/test it.

node = "22"

[tasks.install]
description = "Install npm dependencies"

run = "npm install"

[tasks.test]
description = "Run the unit test suite (node:test via tsx, no build step required)"
run = "npm run test:unit"

depends = ["install"]

[tasks.typecheck]
description = "Type-check with tsc --noEmit (no emitted output)"
run = "npm run typecheck"

depends = ["install"]

[tasks.build]
description = "Bundle src/index.ts -> dist/accso-ai-context.js (scripts/build.mjs)"
run = "npm run build"

depends = ["install"]

[tasks.setup]
description = "Build, then install the bundled plugin file + its native-dependency package.json into OpenCode's global plugin directory (~/.config/opencode/)"
run = "./scripts/install-plugin.sh"

depends = ["install", "build"]

[tasks.ci]
description = "Everything a CI/pre-flight check should run: typecheck + full unit suite"
symbol: description = "Everything a CI/pre-flight check should run

text: depends = ["typecheck", "test"]

Purpose: Package.json is the configuration file for the OpenCode AI Context plugin, defining its name, version, dependencies, and scripts for testing, type checking, building, and dumping ASTs.
Main Responsibilities: Manages the plugin's dependencies, defines scripts for testing and building, and specifies the main entry point of the plugin.
Key Names: "name", "version", "dependencies", "scripts", "main".

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs the bundled opencode-ai-context-plugin into OpenCode's GLOBAL
# plugin directory (~/.config/opencode/plugins/), as
# `accso-ai-context.js`, and ensures its native runtime dependencies
# (onnxruntime-node, tokenizers, @huggingface/hub,
# ignore, @opentelemetry/api, web-tree-sitter + grammar packages) are resolvable from there.
#
# Why global, not project-level (`.opencode/plugins/`): this plugin is
# meant to be usable across every repo a contributor works in, not
# re-installed per project (see docs/adr/0015-single-bundled-plugin-file.md).
#
# Why a package.json in the config directory: OpenCode's local-plugin
# loader does not `npm install` a plugin's own dependencies -- for a
# single bundled JS file to `import` native packages like
# `better-sqlite3` at runtime, those packages must already be resolvable
# from OpenCode's own config directory. OpenCode runs `bun install`
# against `~/.config/opencode/package.json` at startup (see
# https://opencode.ai/docs/plugins/#dependencies), so this script
# merges this plugin's runtime dependency versions into that file
# instead of overwriting whatever else may already be listed there
# (e.g. another plugin's own dependencies).
set -euo pipefail

# Install the dependencies right away instead of waiting for OpenCode's
# next startup, so a freshly added grammar/native package can't be missing
# when the plugin first loads. Same package manager OpenCode itself uses
# (bun), with npm as fallback. Skip with SKIP_DEPS_INSTALL=1.
if [ "${SKIP_DEPS_INSTALL:-0}" != "1" ]; then
  echo
  if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Installing dependencies with bun in $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR ..."
    (cd "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR" && bun install)
  elif command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "bun not found; installing dependencies with npm in $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR ..."
    (cd "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund)
  else
    echo "warning: neither bun nor npm found; OpenCode will install dependencies at its next startup." >&2
  fi

echo
echo "Done. Restart OpenCode to load the plugin."

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PLUGIN_ROOT="$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")"
BUNDLE_NAME="accso-ai-context.js"
BUNDLE_SRC="$PLUGIN_ROOT/dist/$BUNDLE_NAME"

OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR="${OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.config/opencode}"
PLUGIN_DIR="$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/plugins"
DEPS_PACKAGE_JSON="$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/package.json"

if [ ! -f "$BUNDLE_SRC" ]; then
  echo "error: $BUNDLE_SRC not found -- run 'npm run build' (or 'mise run build') first." >&2
  exit 1
fi

mkdir -p "$PLUGIN_DIR"
cp "$BUNDLE_SRC" "$PLUGIN_DIR/$BUNDLE_NAME"
if [ -f "$BUNDLE_SRC.map" ]; then
  cp "$BUNDLE_SRC.map" "$PLUGIN_DIR/$BUNDLE_NAME.map"
fi
echo "Installed $BUNDLE_NAME -> $PLUGIN_DIR/$BUNDLE_NAME"

# Shared embedding worker: lives next to (NOT inside) plugins/, because
# opencode loads every file in plugins/ as a plugin. Resolves its native
# deps from $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/node_modules like the plugin does.
WORKER_NAME="ai-context-worker.mjs"
if [ -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/dist/$WORKER_NAME" ]; then
  cp "$PLUGIN_ROOT/dist/$WORKER_NAME" "$OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/$WORKER_NAME"
  echo "Installed $WORKER_NAME -> $OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/$WORKER_NAME"
fi

const pluginRoot = process.argv[1];
const depsPackageJsonPath = process.argv[2];

/**
 * Project-level YAML config file (user-directed, 2026-09-16): a single,
 * team-committable place for every AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_* knob that
 * previously only had an env-var interface -- `data_dir`,
 * `model_cache_dir`, `embed_dims`, `heavy_mode`. Lives at
 * `.opencode/ai-context.config.yaml` inside the project worktree (see
 * `resolveConfigFilePath`), alongside this plugin's other `.opencode/`
 * metadata (repo-local backup, cross-repo allow-list).
 *
 * Precedence, per each setting's own consuming module (heavy-mode.ts,
 * model-runtime.ts, project-key.ts): explicit function option (tests) >
 * env var > this config file > built-in default -- "env vars become
 * overrides on top of the file" (user-directed). This module only
 * covers reading/parsing/validating the file itself; the actual
 * precedence merge happens where each setting is consumed.
 *
 * Deliberately fault-tolerant, matching this plugin's other
 * user-authored-file handling (`backup.ts`'s per-row validation): a
 * missing file, an empty file, unknown keys, wrong-typed values, or
 * outright malformed YAML all degrade to "no override from the file"
 * (logged, not thrown) rather than crashing the whole plugin over one
 * bad config line.
 */

/** OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, OpenAI, ...) used to write file summaries. */

Purpose: Reads and validates the AI context configuration file for a project.
Main responsibilities: Parses YAML content, checks for valid types and formats, and returns a configuration object with defaults if the file is missing or malformed.
Key names: `SummaryLlmConfig`, `AiContextConfigFile`, `ConfigFileFs`, `resolveConfigFilePath`, `warn`, `loadConfigFile`

import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { resolveConfigFilePath } from "./config-file.js";

/**
 * Template written on first start so users see every knob with its built-in default.
 * `enabled: false` makes the plugin opt-in per repository. Machine-specific keys
 * (data_dir, model_cache_dir, embed_dims) and optional ones (exclude, heavy_mode)
 * stay commented out. Values must equal the built-in defaults (config-template.test.ts).
 */
export const CONFIG_TEMPLATE = `# .opencode/ai-context.config.yaml -- created by opencode-ai-context-plugin.
# Every setting is shown with its built-in default; edit a value to change it.
# Precedence: environment variable > this file > built-in default.

# Master switch for this repository. false (also when the key is missing): the
# plugin does nothing here (no indexing, no tools, no background work) and only
# keeps this file. Set it to true to switch the plugin on. The environment
# variable AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_ENABLED (1/0) overrides it.
enabled: false

# Extra paths that are never indexed (gitignore syntax, on top of .gitignore).
# Applies to the startup scan, the file watcher and the indexer; excluded
# directories are not descended into. Stored chunks of newly excluded files are
# removed when the file is re-indexed.
# exclude:
#   - legacy/
#   - "*.generated.ts"

# Soft RSS ceiling (MiB) of the host process while indexing; over it, indexing
# stops with an error in .opencode/ai-context/index-status.json. A guard, not a hard
/** Writes the template if the config file is missing. Never overwrites; never throws. Returns true if created. */

# cap (a process cannot cap itself); the real bound is embed_max_tokens.
max_memory_mb: 6144

# Threads onnxruntime uses for embedding (lower = less CPU/fan).
embed_threads: 6

# Files indexed in parallel; also the number of inferences the shared worker runs at
# once (each costs transient RAM). 1 = sequential.
embed_concurrency: 3

# Token cap per embedded text; memory grows quadratically with it (512 tokens
# ~0.5 GB, 4096 ~4.5 GB). Chunks are split to fit.
embed_max_tokens: 512

# Files larger than this many bytes are skipped.
max_file_bytes: 1048576

# Native OS popups (plugin started, indexing started/finished/failed).
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_OS_NOTIFICATIONS=0 silences them.
os_notifications: true

# Append a short hint to the agent's system prompt so it prefers semantic_search /
# analyze_impact over grep/glob for conceptual questions.
agent_hint: true

# Protocol every tool call (tool, arguments, short response summary) to
# .opencode/ai-context/tool.log.md (git-ignored; at 5 MB it is rotated to tool.<time>.log.md, newest 10 kept). For finding out
# why the agent chose or misused a tool.
tool_log: false

# With tool_log: no truncation at all, complete arguments and complete response text.
# Code from the repo (and from linked repos) then ends up in the log file.
tool_log_full_responses: false

# Re-rank the best search candidates with a small cross-encoder model
# (Xenova/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2, ~23 MB, downloaded once, runs in the shared

# worker). Improves the order of results at a few ms per candidate.
reranker: true

# Index one summary chunk per file with several chunks, so "what does this file
# do" questions hit the file. Deterministic (symbols + leading comment) unless
# summary_llm is set.
file_summaries: true

# File summaries are written by an OpenAI-compatible server (the local oMLX server
# below by default). File content is sent to base_url, so keep it local. model is
# the exact name the server lists. The API key is NEVER stored here (this file is
# meant to be committed): export it as the environment variable named by
# api_key_env, e.g. export AI_CONTEXT_SUMMARY_LLM_API_KEY=<your key>. Without a
# variable no key is sent; an HTTP 401 then tells you to set it. Unreachable or
# failing server: deterministic summaries are used and rewritten on a later start
# once it answers.
# Set "summary_llm: false" to never call an LLM. For LM Studio use e.g.
# base_url http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1 with model qwen2.5-coder-3b-instruct-mlx
# (no key needed).
summary_llm:
  base_url: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1
  model: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct-MLX-4bit
  api_key_env: AI_CONTEXT_SUMMARY_LLM_API_KEY
  # timeout_ms: 60000

# One-off re-indexing on the next start; the plugin sets the flag back to false
# once the run finished. reindex_chunks re-chunks and re-embeds every file (keeping
# the stored summaries), reindex_summaries rewrites the file summaries only (use it
# after the summary LLM was down), both true re-indexes everything.
reindex_chunks: false

reindex_summaries: false

# Run the embedding model in ONE shared background process (started on demand,
# shared by all opencode instances, exits when idle or above max_memory_mb)
# instead of inside opencode. Falls back to in-process if it cannot start.
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_SHARED_WORKER=0 disables it.
shared_worker: true

# Install the bundled index-status skill into .opencode/skills of this
# project (a SKILL.md you edited yourself is never overwritten).
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_INSTALL_SKILLS=0 disables it.
install_skills: true

# Where the per-project SQLite index lives; must be OUTSIDE the worktree (else the
# plugin's own writes re-trigger indexing; this is not validated).
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_DATA_DIR. Default: ~/.local/share/opencode-ai-context-plugin
# data_dir: /Users/me/.local/share/opencode-ai-context-plugin

# Embedding model cache; unset = the shared Hugging Face cache (one copy of the
# model for all tools). Only set it for a plugin-private or air-gapped cache.
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_MODEL_CACHE_DIR
# model_cache_dir: /Users/me/.cache/ai-context-plugin/models

# Matryoshka truncation of the 768-dim vectors (positive integer <= 768): faster
# search on big repos, slightly lower quality; changing it requires a re-index.
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_EMBED_DIMS
# embed_dims: 256

# Reserved for future heavy-mode-only features (no effect today).
# Environment variable: AI_CONTEXT_PLUGIN_HEAVY_MODE
# heavy_mode: false
`;

/**
 * In-process embedding via manual onnxruntime-node inference -- the
 * corrected embedding-backend decision recorded in plan.md
 * (2026-09-15). Replaces the earlier flawed plan of using the npm
 * `fastembed` package with `nomic-embed-text-v1.5`: that package's
 * `EmbeddingModel` catalog doesn't include nomic at all, and its
 * `getEmbeddings()` extraction is hardcoded to the first token
 * position (CLS pooling) rather than the attention-mask-weighted mean
 * pooling nomic-embed-text-v1.5 was actually trained with -- it would
 * silently produce degraded embeddings with no error. See plan.md's
 * fastembed/nomic audit for the full comparison against
 * `@huggingface/transformers` and forking `fastembed-js`.
 *
 * This module owns exactly the pieces that decision requires us to
 * hand-roll: mean pooling, L2 normalization, and Matryoshka dimension
 * truncation (a nomic-specific lever -- the model was trained so that
 * truncating its 768-dim output to a shorter prefix and re-normalizing
 * still yields a usable embedding, directly cutting the storage
 * spike's brute-force cosine search cost). Tokenization and ONNX
 * session management are injected as `tokenize`/`runInference`
 * dependencies so this module's own logic stays free of any real
 * network/native-binding I/O in unit tests -- a real default
 * implementation (reusing `@huggingface/hub`'s `downloadFileToCacheDir`
 * for model/tokenizer fetch + caching, a tokenizer package, and

# Index status — follow and tune plugin indexing

The plugin writes `.opencode/ai-context/index-status.json` in the project
worktree (atomically, at most every 2 s). It is the only progress channel that
works under ACP; OS popups only mark start/finish/failure.

## 1. Read it once

```bash
cat .opencode/ai-context/index-status.json
```

Fields: `phase` (`idle|scanning|loading-model|indexing|done|failed`), `done`,
`total`, `percent`, `etaSeconds`, `filesPerSec`, `currentFile`, `failed`,
`failures[]` (file, error, attempts), `lastError`.

## 2. Live view: give the user the command

When the user wants to follow progress live, do this and nothing more:

1. Read the JSON file once (step 1) and report phase, percent, ETA and
   failures in a few lines.
2. Give the user this command to run in their own terminal (replace
   `<worktree>` with the absolute project path):

```bash
<worktree>/.opencode/skills/index-status/scripts/watch-index-status.sh
```

NEVER run `watch-ind

ex-status.sh` yourself, with any tool: it loops forever,
blocks or aborts your call, and the user cannot see its output. macOS has no
`watch`; the script (uses `jq` if present, plain `cat` otherwise) is the
replacement. Do not start loops or background watchers either.

## 3. Interpret

- `loading-model`: first embedding call downloads/loads the model; normal, one time.
- `failed` + `lastError` mentioning `max_memory_mb`: the memory guard stopped
  indexing. Lower `embed_max_tokens`/`max_file_bytes` or raise `max_memory_mb`.
- `failures[]` with `skipped: file is N bytes`: file over `max_file_bytes`; it is
  skipped and retried automatically when it changes.
- Fan/CPU high: lower `embed_threads` (default 2).
- Noise from generated/legacy code: add patterns to `exclude:`.

All keys live in `.opencode/ai-context.config.yaml` (auto-created, commented).
Restart opencode after editing it.
';
